meta.title: Service Providers — consolidated, re-verified 2026-11-07
meta.scope: Union of every licence cited by any parallel session on this repository (11 from the original root dashboard + 11 surfaced by the bathtub/, bathtub-overflow/ and trip-lever/ dossiers).
meta.verification_note: Every licence below was re-retrieved from the official CSLB licence-detail page on 2026-11-07 and the page's own 'Data current as of' timestamp is recorded in project/cslb_verification_2026-11-07.json. Nothing on this page is inferred: fields the CSLB page does not state are left blank, and ratings are shown only as dated third-party snapshots.
meta.cslb_note: CSLB states licence status can change at any time; re-check the linked CSLB page on the day you sign.
